profile_text.body:
Credo AI, founded in 2020, describes itself as the trusted leader in AI governance. The company's platform enables enterprises to discover AI systems, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, and applications. According to the company, it created the AI governance category and is now defining governance for the agentic era.

The Credo AI platform is powered by a Knowledge Graph that combines global regulatory intelligence with business context and is supported by forward-deployed experts. The company offers ready-to-deploy policy packs for EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001, written by team members involved in creating AI governance standards at ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and OECD. The platform includes GAIA (Govern AI Assistant), which the company describes as compressing weeks of governance work into hours, and features native integrations across existing enterprise stacks with over 300 integration points.

Credo AI's governance coverage extends from pilot to production stages, treating agents as first-class governed entities alongside models and applications. The company states it did not add AI features to an existing GRC tool but built the platform for what it calls Measurable Trust from the ground up. Customers quoted on the company site include Mastercard, IBM, and organizations in insurance, financial services, federal, and healthcare sectors.
